# Benchmark

Create the results matrix

```{r}
results_quartet = matrix(nrow = 100, 
                 ncol = 7, 
                 data = numeric(),
                 dimnames = list(
  paste("Tree_", 0:99),
  c("NJ", "UNJ", "MP_mean", "MP_SC", "ML", "FBD_MCC", "FBD_MRC")
))
results_grf = matrix(nrow = 100, 
                 ncol = 7, 
                 data = numeric(),
                 dimnames = list(
  paste("Tree_", 0:99),
   c("NJ", "UNJ", "MP_mean", "MP_SC", "ML", "FBD_MCC", "FBD_MRC")
))
```

And now iterate and score:

```{r, echo=FALSE}
for(i in 0:99){
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    # Load data and gt tree
    ## load, clean, write, read each nexus file
    ### Data first
    raw <- readLines(paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    # create the dates vector for bayesian methods
    matches <- regmatches(raw, regexec("ms_([0-9]+)\\|([0-9]+)", raw))
    matched_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(matches, function(x) if(length(x) == 3) x[2:3] else NULL))
    # Create a lookup vector: c("305" = 246, "108" = 120, ...)
    dates_vector <- setNames(as.numeric(matched_matrix[,2]), matched_matrix[,1])
    # and now clean the names to avoid issues with nexus reading
    clean_raw <- gsub("ms\\_|[|]\\S*", "", raw)
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".nex")
    writeLines(clean_raw, tmp)
    data <- ape::read.nexus.data(tmp)
    unlink(tmp)
    data = phyDat(data, type = "USER", levels = 0:10, ambiguity=NA)
    ### Then GT, without forgetting the 0-length edge conversion
    gt_raw = readLines(con = paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    gt <- convert_gt_internal_nodes(gt_raw)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  # Perform analyses
  #dm <- dist.ml(data)
  #treeNJ <- NJ(dm)
  dm <- dist.hamming(data)
  treeNJ<- NJ(dm)
  treeUNJ <- UNJ(dm)
  mm_start <- treeNJ#random.addition(data)
  # Applying the pratchet method for maximum parsimony
  # Default, fitch + SPR
  mm_tree <- pratchet(data, start = mm_start, minit = 10, maxit = 10000, all = TRUE, trace = 0, method = "fitch", rearrangements = "SPR", perturbation = "ratchet")
  ## Maximum likelihood
  fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data)
  fit_opt <- optim.pml(
    fit_mk, 
    optNni = TRUE,      # Optimize topology via NNI
    optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
    #optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
    control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  )
  # And now bayesian FBD-based analysis
  BI = fbd(data,
                 dates_vector,
                 template_file =
                   #"beast_templates/BDSKY_serial.xml",
                   "beast_templates/FBD_NJinit_serial.xml",
                 out = 
                   paste("rbeast_out/", "sequences_", i, sep=""),
                 chain_length=1000000, 
                 bin_folder = beast_bin_folder)
  
  results_quartet[i+1, "NJ"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(gt, treeNJ, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_quartet[i+1, "UNJ"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(gt, treeUNJ, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_quartet[i+1, "MP_mean"] <- mean(Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(mm_tree, cf=gt, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE))# taking the mean. Other option: take a consensus tree
  results_quartet[i+1, "MP_SC"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(consensus(mm_tree, p = 1), cf=gt, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_quartet[i+1, "ML"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(fit_opt$tree, cf=gt, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)

  
  results_grf[i+1, "NJ"] <- TreeDist::TreeDistance(gt, treeNJ)
  results_grf[i+1, "UNJ"] <- TreeDist::TreeDistance(gt, treeUNJ)
  results_grf[i+1, "MP_mean"] <- mean(TreeDist::TreeDistance(mm_tree, gt))# taking the mean. Other option: take a consensus tree
  results_grf[i+1, "MP_SC"] <- TreeDist::TreeDistance(consensus(mm_tree, p = 1), gt)
  results_grf[i+1, "ML"] <- mean(TreeDist::TreeDistance(fit_opt$tree, gt))
  
  if(!is.null(BI)){
    results_quartet[i+1, "FBD_MCC"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(gt, BI$mcc_tree, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_grf[i+1, "FBD_MCC"] <- TreeDist::TreeDistance(gt, BI$mcc_tree)
  results_quartet[i+1, "FBD_MRC"] <- Quartet::QuartetDivergence(Quartet::QuartetStatus(gt, BI$mrc_tree, nTip = TRUE), similarity = FALSE)
  results_grf[i+1, "FBD_MRC"] <- TreeDist::TreeDistance(gt, BI$mrc_tree)
  
  }
}
```


# Quartet distance

Now plot:

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
res = as.data.frame(results_quartet)
ggplot(data = res) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "NJ", y = NJ)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "UNJ", y = UNJ)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "MP (mean)", y = MP_mean)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "MP (SC)", y = MP_SC)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "ML", y = ML)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "FBD (MCC)", y = FBD_MCC)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "FBD (MRC)", y = FBD_MRC)) +
  #geom_boxplot(aes(x = "BDSky", y = FBD)) +
  xlab("Method") +
  ylab("Quartet distance") +
  ggtitle("Unrooted trees quartet distance to GT", subtitle =  "(local agreements/families)")
```

results_quartet
```

# Information-based Generalised Robinson-Foulds distance

```{r}
res = as.data.frame(results_grf)
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(data = res) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "NJ", y = NJ)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "UNJ", y = UNJ)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "MP (mean)", y = MP_mean)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "MP (SC)", y = MP_SC)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "ML", y = ML)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "FBD (MCC)", y = FBD_MCC)) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = "FBD (MRC)", y = FBD_MRC)) +
  #geom_boxplot(aes(x = "BDSky", y = FBD)) +
  xlab("Method") +
  ylab("gRF dissimilarity") +
  ggtitle("Unrooted trees gRF distance to GT", sub="(Topology)")
```

# Save the ML trees to disk

```{r}
for(i in 0:99){
  attempt <- tryCatch({
    # Load data and gt tree
    ## load, clean, write, read each nexus file
    ### Data first
    raw <- readLines(paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/sequences_", i, ".nex", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    # create the dates vector for bayesian methods
    matches <- regmatches(raw, regexec("ms_([0-9]+)\\|([0-9]+)", raw))
    matched_matrix <- do.call(rbind, lapply(matches, function(x) if(length(x) == 3) x[2:3] else NULL))
    # Create a lookup vector: c("305" = 246, "108" = 120, ...)
    dates_vector <- setNames(as.numeric(matched_matrix[,2]), matched_matrix[,1])
    # and now clean the names to avoid issues with nexus reading
    clean_raw <- gsub("ms\\_|[|]\\S*", "", raw)
    tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".nex")
    writeLines(clean_raw, tmp)
    data <- ape::read.nexus.data(tmp)
    unlink(tmp)
    data = phyDat(data, type = "USER", levels = 0:10, ambiguity=NA)
    ### Then GT, without forgetting the 0-length edge conversion
    gt_raw = readLines(con = paste("simulations_data/simulated_traditions_22_07/tree_", i, ".newick", sep = ""), warn = FALSE)
    gt <- convert_gt_internal_nodes(gt_raw)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # Print a warning showing which file failed
    message(sprintf("Skipping iteration %d due to error: %s", i, e$message))
    return(NULL)
  })
  
  # --- 2. Skip to next iteration if loading failed ---
  if (is.null(attempt)) {
    next
  }
  # Perform analyses
  #dm <- dist.ml(data)
  #treeNJ <- NJ(dm)
  dm <- dist.hamming(data)
  treeNJ<- NJ(dm)
  fit_mk <- pml(treeNJ, data = data)
  fit_opt <- optim.pml(
    fit_mk, 
    optNni = TRUE,      # Optimize topology via NNI
    optEdge = TRUE,     # Optimize branch lengths
    #optGamma = TRUE,    # Fit +G (Gamma rate variation across site variants)
    control = pml.control(trace = 0)
  )
  
  write.tree(fit_opt$tree, file=paste("ml_out/", i, ".tree", sep=""))

}
